claims.claim: The North Atlantic right whale population was estimated at about 382 at the end of 2025, seven fewer than a year earlier and 20 percent below 483 in 2011.
claims.episode_span: about 382 animals at the end of 2025 — seven fewer than a year earlier, 20 percent below the most recent peak of 483 in 2011
claims.source_title: North Atlantic right whale population declines as U.S. weakens protections
claims.supporting_quote: The latest estimate , released Monday by the North Atlantic Right Whale Consortium at its annual meeting in Halifax, puts the population at about 382 animals at the end of 2025. That’s seven fewer than a year earlier and 20-per-cent below its most recent peak of 483 in 2011.
